title: Glowing fire truck
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground glow shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='42' ry='5' fill='#2a1450'/>
  <!-- ladder -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='14' y='30' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <rect x='18' y='30' width='3' height='8' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <rect x='30' y='30' width='3' height='8' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='3' height='8' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <rect x='54' y='30' width='3' height='8' fill='#ffb703'/>
  <!-- body of truck -->
  <rect x='10' y='44' width='76' height='24' rx='5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <rect x='10' y='44' width='76' height='7' rx='4' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- cab -->
  <rect x='62' y='38' width='24' height='30' rx='5' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <rect x='66' y='44' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#a8e0ff'/>

  <rect x='64' y='34' width='20' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#7be0ff'/>

  <circle cx='78' cy='36.5' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <rect x='16' y='54' width='14' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffb3b8'/>

  <rect x='52' y='54' width='12' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffb3b8'/>
  <!-- hose reel -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='77' r='8' fill='#2a1450'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='77' r='6' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='77' r='2.5' fill='#2a1450'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3a1a6e'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='78' r='5' fill='#a8e0ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3a1a6e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='5' fill='#a8e0ff'/>
